name: Minnesota
eyebrow: Xcel Energy · CenterPoint · Minnesota Power · Rochester
short: Minnesota rebates come from your gas and electric companies. Minnesota Power pays $1,000 for a cold-climate heat pump, Rochester Public Utilities up to $2,200, and CenterPoint Energy $1,100 to add a heat pump to a gas furnace. Xcel Energy pays up to $3,000 for insulation and its heat pump amounts could not be confirmed on a current page. Minneapolis adds up to $5,000. The state's own HOMES and HEAR rebates have not launched, and we could not confirm any federal tax credit for 2026.
